mapper.sql: l.id AS id, l.media_id AS mediaId, l.creator_id AS creatorId, l.token_hash AS tokenHash, l.expires_at AS expiresAt, l.revoked_at AS revokedAt, l.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO share_link (id, media_id, creator_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{l.id}, #{l.mediaId}, #{l.creatorId}, #{l.tokenHash}, #{l.expiresAt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM share_link l WHERE l.id = #{shareId}
SELECT FROM share_link l WHERE l.token_hash = #{tokenHash}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM share_link WHERE media_id = #{mediaId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE share_link SET revoked_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{shareId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
